lead.headline: Your F-1 Visa, Step by Step
lead.deck: From I-20 to interview day: the four steps every admitted student follows
body: After a US university accepts you, it issues your Form I-20. You then pay the SEVIS fee, complete the DS-160 application online and book an interview at the nearest US Embassy or Consulate.

Strong financial documents and clear answers about your study plans matter most on interview day. Tutee Connect runs one-on-one mock interviews so you walk in prepared. The final decision always rests with the consular officer.
lead.caption: From your I-20 to interview day, every step has a checklist.

stories.headline: Up to 36 Months of Practical Training
stories.deck: How OPT and the STEM OPT extension may add up
body: Eligible F-1 graduates may work for up to 12 months on OPT. Graduates of qualifying STEM degrees may apply for a further 24-month extension, subject to USCIS approval.

stories.headline: Loans Without Collateral, Explained
stories.deck: Our banking partners cover tuition and living costs
body: Tutee Connect works with reputed banks and lenders on both collateral and non-collateral education loans, and connects students directly with bank executives.

stories.headline: Earn While You Learn
body: On an F-1 visa you can usually work on campus for up to 20 hours a week while classes are in session, and more during official breaks.

stories.headline: English Tests: Which One to Take?
body: Most US universities accept TOEFL or IELTS, and many accept PTE or the Duolingo English Test. Minimum scores vary, so we match tests to your shortlist.

stories.headline: Your First Counselling Session Is Free
stories.deck: Talk to our Chennai and Dubai teams
body: Your first career consultation with Tutee Connect is free. Share your details and a counsellor will map out your US route with you.

stories.headline: Landing Day Checklist
stories.deck: SSN, bank account, insurance and housing
body: Our post-landing support helps with accommodation, your Social Security Number, a US bank account and understanding medical insurance.
